title: Microsoft BANNED This Developer! (Plus the New LatinVFR A380)
description:
📝 Description
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator hangar this week, or are you just trying to navigate past the landmines on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a massive wave of recent Marketplace changes that represent both a historic cleanup and a highly anticipated heavyweight entry to the simulator.

We dive deep into high-fidelity heavy hitters like the brand-new LatinVFR Airbus A380-800 to see if this legendary double-decker giant delivers an immersive international airliner experience. Packing an advanced FMS with SIDs/STARs, operational step climbs, CAT III dual autoland, and a live ECAM system with dozens of operational warning messages, it brings an accessible yet deep heavy transport to the sim. We look closely at both the Rolls-Royce Trent 970 and Engine Alliance GP7200 engine variants, explore the custom cabin configurations—including the premium Emirates interior—and see if this is the super-heavyweight your long-haul schedules have been waiting for.

⚠️ CRITICAL MARKETPLACE WARNING: We are highlighting a historic development on the storefront because Microsoft has officially banned and completely scrapped the controversial third-party developer MScenery from the Marketplace. Following months of intensive community feedback and a wave of low-effort releases, Microsoft stepped in to address severe quality concerns, misleading product listings, and suspicious rating manipulation. We discuss why this storefront purge is an absolute win for consumer transparency, how it changes the quality control landscape of the MSFS store, and why low-effort asset flips will no longer crowd out high-quality creators.

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know your thoughts on the marketplace cleanup or the new A380!
